cron.description: Five-field cron in the named time zone.

model.description: An explicit provider model ID; empty for rehearsal or a managed local process.

reasoningEffort.description: Provider-advertised reasoning effort ID; omit or empty for provider default. Validated against the live model at execution.

mcpServers.description: Provider-compatible MCP definitions. Use local environment or keychain for credentials.

contextSelection.description: Source IDs from the local context catalog, resolved for each new run. Omit for workspace defaults.

includeDefaults.description: False loads only selected sources/main agent and excludes legacy skillDirectories/mcpServers.

source.description: Optional upstream manifest provenance. Host-resolved paths stay outside Git.

contextTier.description: Provider-advertised context tier ID; omit or default for provider default. Copilot currently advertises default and, where available, long_context.

serviceTier.description: Provider-advertised service tier ID; empty or omitted for provider default.

integration.description: Managed integration identity. Omi commands and execution permissions are resolved from private host settings.
